title: Runtime dataset browser/CDN cache hardening
trigger: Mobile production UI reported Hobby runtime data contract failure while repository CI remained green.
root_cause: Runtime fingerprints invalidated BreakMetric's in-memory cache but versioned dataset network requests reused stable JSON URLs, allowing browser or CDN HTTP caches to return a mixture of deployment generations.
changes: Versioned dataset requests append the 64-character runtime fingerprint as a query parameter.
Versioned dataset network requests use no-store so browser HTTP cache cannot satisfy them with an older representation.
The version manifest continues to use no-store and stable-version before/after checks.
index.html explicitly requests dataLoader.js?v=4 so existing clients do not retain loader v3.
Regression tests assert URL fingerprinting, no-store dataset fetches, version transitions and loader script cache busting.
guarantees: Clean dataset paths remain subject to the existing same-origin data/*.json guard.
The fingerprint query is generated internally and cannot bypass the path guard.
Same-fingerprint in-memory cache reuse remains enabled.
A fingerprint change produces a different network URL and clears the in-memory dataset cache.
Mid-load deployment changes still trigger a stable-version retry before data activation.
